reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getFillableCategories selection and reads spending through getSheetValue, so it inherits the hidden/template exclusions.

duplication.why: It repeats the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the income/expense sign flip inline, as every sibling action already does, rather than adding them to the shared selection.

placement.why: The action sits beside setZero and the average actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the new action and its registration.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its siblings; the income rule still lives per action, so a change to it means touching this copy too.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getFillableCategories, the shared month-wide selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income skip has the same shape as in the siblings; not disguised.
